title: Functional specialization and wages in Europe
title_zh: 欧洲的功能专业化与工资
authors: Roman Stöllinger, Sandra M. Leitner, Zuzana Zavarska
abstract: This paper investigates the relationship between functional specialization (FS) in global value chains (GVCs) and wages. Drawing on the GVC theory and intellectual monopoly capitalism theory, both highlighting asymmetries in international production and knowledge networks, it is postulated that FS in fabrication and FS in research and development (R&D) have differentiated effects on the evolution of wages. To test this hypothesis, we embed measures of FS in a structural wage regression and estimate the relationship for 25 EU countries over the period 2003–2022. We find some evidence for this hypothesis, notably a negative association between FS in fabrication and wages. Furthermore, we obtain partial confirmation of the expected patterns in our instrumental variable regressions, although the findings are not fully robust across all specifications.
abstract_zh: 本文探讨了全球价值链（GVC）中的功能专业化（FS）与工资之间的关系。基于全球价值链理论与智力垄断资本主义理论（两者均强调国际生产与知识网络中的不对称性），本文提出假设：制造功能专业化与研发（R&D）功能专业化对工资演变具有差异化影响。为验证该假设，我们将功能专业化指标嵌入结构性工资回归模型，并对2003-2022年间25个欧盟国家进行估计。研究结果部分支持该假设，尤其发现制造功能专业化与工资呈负相关关系。此外，工具变量回归虽部分验证了预期模式，但该结论在所有模型设定中并非完全稳健。

title: Youth Crime and Delinquency In And Out Of School
title_zh: 青少年犯罪与逃学及在校行为
authors: Janine Boshoff, Stephen Machin, Matteo Sandi
abstract: Abstract Ten years of idiosyncratic variation in school closure dates for all secondary schools in England are combined with administrative records of educational and criminal trajectories linked at the individual level to study the impact of the school schedule on the dynamics of youth crime. When school is not in session, students commit more property offences, more serious violent offences and fewer minor violent offences. Increased thefts, robberies and violent assaults drive these effects. This is novel evidence of strong multiple crime effects that arise from the protective factor of schooling and which affect not only the incidence of violence, but also its severity and its targets.
abstract_zh: 摘要：本文利用英格兰所有中学十年间因特殊原因导致的停课日期变化，结合个体层面关联的教育与犯罪轨迹行政记录，研究学校作息安排对青少年犯罪动态的影响。当学校停课时，学生实施的财产犯罪、严重暴力犯罪增加，而轻微暴力犯罪减少。盗窃、抢劫和暴力袭击的增加是导致这些效应的主要原因。本研究首次提供了强有力的多重犯罪效应证据，这些效应源于学校教育的保护性因素，不仅影响暴力犯罪的发生率，还影响其严重程度及目标对象。

title: Insurance with Multiple Actors
authors: Jason Abaluck, Oren Sarig, Jintaek Song
official: 官方在线 2026-06-22 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: We analyze how social-planner insurers split cost-sharing between consumers and firms (e.g. patients and doctors, or drivers and car mechanics). With no contracting frictions, firm cost-sharing can replace consumer cost-sharing other than “visit copays.” Optimal firm contracts depend on the marginal rate of substitution between consumer and firm cost-sharing. For Medicare physician services, paying physicians more up front but less as spending increases reduces risk for both patients and providers; in our calibration, net benefits are twice those from eliminating Medigap externality. For prescription drugs, a dollar of physician paperwork costs is 45–110 times more impactful than a dollar of consumer cost-sharing.
abstract_zh: 我们分析了社会规划型保险公司如何在消费者与企业（例如患者与医生，或驾驶员与汽车修理工）之间分摊成本。在不存在契约摩擦的情况下，除"就诊共付额"外，企业成本分摊可替代消费者成本分摊。最优企业契约取决于消费者与企业成本分摊之间的边际替代率。以医疗保险医生服务为例，提高预付比例但降低随支出递增的支付比例，可同时降低患者与医疗服务提供者的风险；在我们的校准模型中，其净收益是消除医疗补充保险外部性收益的两倍。对于处方药而言，医生每增加一美元文书工作成本的影响，是消费者每增加一美元成本分摊的45至110倍。

title: Robust Design and Evaluation of Predictive Algorithms under Unobserved Confounding
title_zh: 未观测混杂下预测算法的稳健设计与评估
authors: Ashesh Rambachan, Amanda Coston, Edward H. Kennedy
abstract: Abstract Predictive algorithms inform consequential decisions in settings with selective labels: outcomes are observed only for units selected by past decision makers. This creates an identification problem under unobserved confounding — when selected and unselected units differ in unobserved ways that affect outcomes. We propose a framework for robust design and evaluation of predictive algorithms that bounds how much outcomes may differ between selected and unselected units with the same observed characteristics. These bounds formalize common empirical strategies including proxy outcomes and instrumental variables. Our estimators work across bounding strategies and performance measures such as conditional likelihoods, mean squared error, and true/false positive rates. Using administrative data from a large Australian financial institution, we show that varying confounding assumptions substantially affects credit risk predictions and fairness evaluations across income groups.
